cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: For the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to state exactly what they did, knew, or authorized before you reveal your own involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Before I show you the fireworks invoice, exactly what did you approve?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you buy the enormous rocket?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. First, did your 'make it memorable' include rockets?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It included sparklers. Nothing that needed a trailer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When did you first mention the trailer limit? I need that date before we get to the delivery date.

mechanism: Misread a colleague's confident use of cleared, then require an exact authorization before exposing an order.
confusable: Distinguish strategic questioning from S04 confusion: B2 reveals cleared meant removing stock, not approving a purchase.
comparison: Commercial launch authorization differs from personal wedding invitations and timestamp checking.
seedUse: Preserves the Drive order/authorization sequence, changes fireworks invoice context to a launch, and uses S04 semantic imitation instead of its seed props.
